Gulf Oil Lubricants has brought on board cricketer Smriti Mandhana, as its new brand ambassador. With this association, Gulf Oil claims to have become the first company in the lubricant space to appoint a woman cricketer as ambassador to represent the organisation and its ethos. Smriti Mandhana will join the ranks of current brand ambassadors Mahendra Singh Dhoni and Hardik Pandya. Through this association, Gulf Oil aims to celebrate women power and inspire female audiences in the country while also honoring the achievements of Indian women cricketers.

When a body moves in a circular path, it is said to be in a circular motion. An object moving in a circular path may have constant speed. While the speed of the object is constant, its velocity is changing.

When the velocity of the object changes, we say that the object is accelerating. The change in the velocity could be due to change in its magnitude or the direction of the motion or both.

For example, if the athlete moves with a velocity of constant magnitude along the circular path, the only change in his velocity is due to the change in the direction of motion. The motion of the athlete moving along a circular path is, therefore, an example of an accelerated motion.

A Bill may be introduced in either House of Parliament. However, a Money Bill can not be introduced in Rajya Sabha. It can only be introduced in Lok Sabha with prior recommendation of the President for introduction in Lok Sabha.

The Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR) is an autonomous organisation under the Department of Agricultural Research and Education (DARE), Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare , Government of India. Formerly known as Imperial Council of Agricultural Research, it was established on 16 July 1929 as a registered society under the Societies Registration Act, 1860 in pursuance of the report of the Royal Commission on Agriculture. The ICAR has its headquarters at New Delhi.

Sangeet Natak Akademi decided to institute "Ustad Bismillah Khan Yuva Puraskar" from the year 2006 to be awarded to artists who have shown / demonstrated conspicuous talent in the fields of music, dance and drama.

Salt, sodium nitrite, spices, vinegar, and alcohol have been used to preserve foods for centuries. Sodium benzoate, calcium propionate, and potassium sorbate are used to prevent microbial growth that causes spoilage and to slow changes in color, texture, and flavor.

Methyl alcohol or Methanol is a toxic alcohol that is used industrially as a solvent, pesticide, and alternative fuel source.

Crude gypsum is used as a fluxing agent, fertilizer, filler in paper and textiles, and retarder in portland cement.

Transgender folk dancer Matha B Manjamma Jogati was honoured with the Padma Shri in 2021, for populating folk dance in rural Karnataka, Tamil Nadu, and Andhra Pradesh. In her 60s, Manjamma Jogati has mastered several art forms, including Jogati Nritya and Janapada songs. Jogati is also known for singing spell-binding sonnets in Kannada in praise of female deities.

A minor chiefly family known as the Muttaraiyar held power in the Kaveri delta. They were subordinate to the Pallava kings of Kanchipuram. Vijayalaya, who belonged to the ancient chiefly family of the Cholas from Uraiyur, captured the delta from the Muttaraiyar in the middle of the ninth century. He built the town of Thanjavur and a temple for goddess Nishumbhasudini there.

The Durand Line is the 2,640-kilometer (1,640-mile) border between Afghanistan and Pakistan. It's the result of an agreement between Sir Mortimer Durand, a secretary of the British Indian government, and Abdur Rahman Khan, the emir, or ruler, of Afghanistan. The agreement was signed on November 12, 1893, in Kabul, Afghanistan.

The Phase - I programme of 'Sagar Parikrama' has been organized in Gujarat, started on 5th March, 2022 from Mandvi and ended on 6th March 2022 at Porbandar, Gujarat.

The Department of Fisheries, Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying, Government of India launched the 'Sagar Parikrama' program on the occasion of 75th Azadi Ka Amrit Mahotsav. Sagar Parikrama program is being organized through a pre-decided sea route covering coastal states/UTs.

India's Raj Angad Bawa was announced Player of the Match of the ICC Under19 World Cup 2022 Final between India and England. The Indian all-rounder picked 5/31, the best bowling figures for any final in the history of the championship and also scored crucial 35 runs with the bat to help his team in its 4 wicket win.

The first Governor-General of India was Warren Hastings, who occupied that high position from 1773 to 1785. The supreme head of the administration was the Governor-General. Warren Hastings, the first Governor-General, introduced several administrative reforms, notably in the sphere of justice. He ended the Dual Government system by enforcing the Regulating Act of 1773.

When a government's expenditures on goods, services, or transfer payments exceed their tax revenue, the government has run a budget deficit.

When tax collection exceeds the required expenditure, the budget is said to be in surplus.

The government may spend an amount equal to the revenue it collects. This is known as a balanced budget.

In 1803, Raja Ram Mohan Roy published a Persian treatise called Tuhfat-ul-Muwahidin or 'A Gift to Monotheists' wherein he explains his concept of monotheism. In his religio-philosophical social outlook, he was deeply influenced by the monotheism and anti-idolatry of Islam, deism of Sufism, the ethical teaching of Christianity, liberal and rationalist doctrines of the West.

Born in Madanapalli, Andhra Pradesh, Yamini Krishnamurthy is a famous dancer of Bharatanatyam and Kuchipudi styles of dance forms. The title of Asthana Narthaki ("Resident Dancer") was bestowed upon her by the Tirumala Tirupathi Devasthanam temple. She published an autobiography (with Renuka Khandekar), A Passion for Dance: An Autobiography, in 1995.

Krishnamurthy received many awards for her work, including the Padma Shri (1968), the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award (1977), and the Padma Bhushan (2001).

questions.question: What is the set of ecosystems called? पारितंत्रों के समुच्चय को क्या कहा जाता है?
questions.solution: Biome is a group of ecosystems which are subject to similar climatic conditions and which share a similar range of vegetation structures, animal diversity, and soil types. Biomes represent major regional groupings of ecological systems and are therefore discernible at the global scale.

Pandit Birju Maharaj who passed away on January 17, 2022, throughout his lifetime, choreographed many popular songs in Bollywood. Mohe Rang Do Laal from Bajirao Mastani choreographed by him deserves credit for the beautiful choreography and powerful Kathak sequences. The Kathak maestro also went on to win a Filmfare Award for Best Choreography in 2016 for the film.

Lithium aluminium hydride, LiAlH4, also abbreviated as LAH, is a strong reducing agent commonly employed in modern organic synthesis. It is a nucleophilic reducing agent, best used to reduce polar multiple bonds like C=O.

It is used to reduce aldehydes, ketones, esters, carboxylic acid chlorides, carboxylic acids and even carboxylate salts to alcohols.

Bhagirathi is the source stream of Ganga. It is considered the headwater of Ganga. It emanates from Gangotri Glacier at Gaumukh at an elevation of 3,892 m (12,770 feet). Many small streams comprise the headwaters of Ganga. The important among these are Alaknanda, Dhauliganga, Pindar, Mandakini and Bhilangana.

In hockey, if the umpire points both arms horizontally towards the goal, it means a penalty corner is awarded.

Other signals:

Free hit - Indicate the direction with one arm raised horizontally and the open hand at face level.

Penalty stroke - One arm points to the penalty spot, the other points straight in the air.

Goal scored - Point both arms horizontally towards the center of the field.

Government of India has appointed Ms. Bharati Das, 1988-batch Indian Civil Accounts Service (ICAS) officer as Controller General of Accounts (CGA), Ministry of Finance, Department of Expenditure.

Controller General of Accounts (CGA) is 'the Principal Advisor' on Accounting matters to the Union Government. CGA is responsible for establishing and managing a technically sound Management Accounting System and preparation & submission of the accounts of the Union Government. CGA is also responsible for exchequer control and internal audits for the central Government.

Tropical humid climates exist between Tropic of Cancer and Tropic of Capricorn. The sun being overhead throughout the year and the presence of Inter Tropical Convergence Zone (ITCZ) make the climate hot and humid. Annual range of temperature is very low and annual rainfall is high. The tropical group is divided into three types as per the climate classification scheme developed by V. Koeppen, namely (i) Af- Tropical wet climate; (ii) Am - Tropical monsoon climate; (iii) Aw- Tropical wet and dry climate.

About 4700 years ago, some of the earliest cities flourished on the banks of these rivers. Later, about 2500 years ago, cities developed on the banks of the Ganga and its tributaries, and along the seacoasts. In ancient times the area along these rivers to the south of the Ganga was known as Magadha.

Kandla Port situated at the head of Gulf of Kuchchh has been developed as a major port to cater to the needs of western and north western parts of the country and also to reduce the pressure at Mumbai port. The port is specially designed to receive large quantities of petroleum and petroleum products and fertiliser. The offshore terminal at Vadinar has been developed to reduce the pressure at Kandla port. Kandla Port Trust was renamed as Deendayal Port Trust with effect from 25th of September, 2017.

The Citizenship Act of 1955 regulates who may acquire Indian citizenship and on what grounds. A person may become an Indian citizen if they are born in India or have Indian parentage or have resided in the country for a period of time, etc. However, illegal migrants are prohibited from acquiring Indian citizenship. An illegal migrant is a foreigner who: (i) enters the country without valid travel documents, like a passport and visa, or (ii) enters with valid documents, but stays beyond the permitted time period.

questions.question: Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph. A. The principal wished the students continued to aim for perfection in their future endeavours. B. The principal also lauded educators for their tireless efforts to educate students and inspired them to come up with new ideas. C. Our college's principal delivered an excellent speech in which he lauded the pupils. D. The principal mentioned how teaching assistants assisted students in resolving academic and social challenges.
questions.questionHtml:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

A. The principal wished the students continued to aim for perfection in their future endeavours.

B. The principal also lauded educators for their tireless efforts to educate students and inspired them to come up with new ideas.

C. Our college's principal delivered an excellent speech in which he lauded the pupils.

D. The principal mentioned how teaching assistants assisted students in resolving academic and social challenges.
questions.solution:
The given set of sentences talk about the speech given by a principal. Sentence C has to be the first sentence in the order as it mentions the premise of the incident. It is followed by sentence D which talks about the part of the principal's speech in which he talks about the role of teaching assistants. Though, sentence B has the possibility to come second in the order, the adverb 'also' indicates that the sentence is an addition to some fact or information that is said or done earlier. So, sentence B cannot be the second sentence, but it is the third sentence in the order. Sentence A is a wish or blessing statement to the students and it usually comes as the last part of a speech and so, sentence A takes the last position. So, the final order of the given sentences is CDBA.

Hence, the correct answer is option (b).

questions.question: Parts of the following sentences have been given as options. Select the option that contains a grammatical error. Bobo was / very richer than Jim / as he had illicitly accumulated / all his wealth.
questions.questionHtml:
Parts of the following sentences have been given as options. Select the option that contains a grammatical error.

Bobo was / very richer than Jim / as he had illicitly accumulated / all his wealth.
questions.solution:
Option (a) has the part with error. The sentence draws a comparison between Bobo and Jim's wealth. For that, an adjective in comparative degree is used and is sufficient to denote the comparison. There is no need to add 'very' before it.

The correct sentence is: Bobo was richer than Jim as he had illicitly accumulated all his wealth.

Hence, the correct answer is option (a).

Note:The Positive Degree is used to denote the mere existence of some quality of what we speak about. It is used when no comparison is made.

The Comparative degree denotes a higher degree of quality than the positive and is used when two things are compared.

The Superlative degree indicates the highest degree of quality and is used when more than two things (or sets of things) are compared.

questions.question: The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error. They all, except Shirin, were very sad / during the farewell party given / to the teacher retiring, and her / indifference were well noticed.
questions.questionHtml:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

They all, except Shirin, were very sad / during the farewell party given / to the teacher retiring, and her / indifference were well noticed.

options.text: They all, except Shirin, were very sad
options.html: They all, except Shirin, were very sad

options.text: to the teacher retiring, and her
options.html: to the teacher retiring, and her

questions.solution:
The part mentioned in option (c) has an error. In the part, the noun 'indifference' is singular which is incorrectly followed by the plural verb 'were' and it leads to error in subject verb agreement. Instead, the singular verb 'was' is to be used.

The correct sentence is: They all, except Shirin, were very sad during the farewell party given to the teacher retiring, and her indifference was well noticed.

Hence, the correct answer is option (c).

Note:

Subject-Verb Agreement: Matching up singular or plural subjects with singular or plural forms of a verb is part of the process called agreement. This can be understood better by the examples given: - "She likes cooking." [singular subject and verb] -- "They like to cook vegetables." [plural subject and verb]

questions.question: Select the word segment that substitutes (replaces) the bracketed word segment correctly and completes the sentence meaningfully: Estella had hardly heard the news (after) she began to weep.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the word segment that substitutes (replaces) the bracketed word segment correctly and completes the sentence meaningfully:

Estella had hardly heard the news (after) she began to weep.
questions.solution:
While- at the same time as

Well- in a good or satisfactory way

Than- used to introduce the second element in a comparison

When- at or during the time that

The sentence talks about a person who begins to weep even before she knows the news. Here, a conjunction that denotes times has to replace the word 'after', which also denotes time. Among the given options, option (d) 'when' is the appropriate word that can replace the word 'after'. Though, option (d) 'while' denotes time, has a different meaning which is not required in the context of the sentence.

Hence, the correct answer is option (d).

questions.question: Select the correct active form of the given sentence. Luckily, the machinery was not used by them.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the correct active form of the given sentence.

Luckily, the machinery was not used by them.

options.text: Luckily, they did not use the machinery.
options.html: Luckily, they did not use the machinery.

options.text: Luckily, they have not used the machinery.
options.html: Luckily, they have not used the machinery.

options.text: Luckily, I did not used the machinery.
options.html: Luckily, I did not used the machinery.

questions.solution:
The subject of the Passive Voice is changed into the object of the Active Voice. Also, the object of the Passive Voice is changed into the subject of the Active Voice.

The removal of the helping verb and the preposition 'by' is necessary while changing the voice of the sentence from Passive to Active.

The Passive voice in this question is in Past Indefinite. Thus, the Active voice will also be in Past Indefinite.

In Passive voice, the format is: Subject (Objective case) + was/were + V3 + by + Object (Subjective Case).

Thus, the format of Active voice is: Subject + V2 + Object.

For example:

The Champions League was won by Real Madrid. (Passive Voice)

Real Madrid won the Champions League. (Active Voice)

Among the given options, the sentence given in option (b) alone satisfies the required condition of Active voice for the given sentence. Options (a) and (c) use Past Perfect tense and option (d) changes the subjective pronoun as 'I', instead of 'they' and so they are negated.

Hence, the correct answer is option (b): Luckily, they did not use the machinery.

Note:

Voice of a sentence - Depending upon the emphasis we want to lay we use a particular voice in a particular context. We use active voice to lay emphasis on the doer of the action while we use passive voice to lay emphasis on the receiver of the action.

Example:

Active- Radha will work. (emphasis on Radha)

Passive- Work will be done by Radha. (emphasis on Work)

questions.solution:
The subject of the Passive Voice is changed into the object of the Active Voice. Also, the object of the Passive Voice is changed into the subject of the Active Voice.

The removal of the "to be" verb ['are' in the given sentence] and the preposition "by" is necessary while changing the voice of the sentence from Passive to Active.

The sentence in Active voice should be in the imperative form. An imperative sentence is used to express order, request, suggestion, etc. They begin with a principal verb in Active Voice. Here, the imperative sentence in Active voice should be a request.

In Active voice, the use of "please", "kindly" is generally present.

"You are requested/asked" is used in the Passive voice.

The format in Passive voice is: You are requested/asked to + V1 ['tell'] + Object ['plumber'].

Thus, the format in Active voice is: V1 ['Tell'] + Object ['plumber'].

For example:

You are requested to wash the dishes as soon as possible. (Passive)

Kindly, wash the dishes as soon as possible. (Active)

Please note that "You are kindly requested to" is a wrong usage in Passive voice.

The options except (b) don't follow the correct grammatical format of the Active Voice.

Therefore,, the correct answer is option (b): Tell the plumber to mend all the pipes.

questions.question: Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. Select the opinion that contains a grammatical error. If you don't find any error, mark 'No error' as your answer. Her concerts / are very admired / by the foreigners / no error.
questions.questionHtml:
Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. Select the opinion that contains a grammatical error. If you don't find any error, mark 'No error' as your answer.

Her concerts / are very admired / by the foreigners / no error.
questions.solution:
The part mentioned in option (a) has an error. We should not use 'very' before past participle form of verb (V3)('admired' in the given sentence) in the passive voice. We use the phrase 'very much' instead.

The given sentence is in passive voice as the action 'admired' is directed at the subject 'her concerts'.

The correct sentence is: Her concerts are very much admired by the foreigners.

Hence, the correct answer is option (a).

Note:Active and Passive Voice: When the person doing the action is the subject, the sentence is said to be in active form/voice. When the subject is what the action is directed at, then the sentence is said to be in passive form/voice. For example: Active Voice: Rita and her friends performed a skit. Here 'Rita and her friends' (subject) perform the action. Passive Voice: A skit was performed by Rita and her friends. Here 'skit' is the subject (at which the action is directed).

Among the options, 'up'(from a lower to a higher point of (something)), 'to' (identifying the person or thing affected by or receiving something) and 'at' ((followed by a noun without a determiner) denoting a particular period of time) are contextually incorrect options and so they are negated. Note:

A Preposition is a word placed before a noun or a pronoun or a noun equivalent (pronoun, adverb, gerund, infinitive, adverbial clause, or any clause that can be used as the object of the preposition) and shows a relationship in space or time or a logical relationship between two or more people, places, or things in a sentence.

Examples

I. The teacher scolded the child for being late.

II. We're going to a party.

· The words in bold are called prepositions because they normally take position before (pre) a noun/pronoun or a noun equivalent (pronoun, adverb, gerund, infinitive, adverbial clause, or any clause that can be used as the object of the preposition.

· The noun/pronoun which is used with a preposition is called its Object.
